query: Which statute replaced the Indian Penal Code, 1860?
Which statute replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973?
Which statute replaced the Indian Evidence Act, 1872?
Did the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 repeal or replace the POCSO Act, 2012?
expected: No, POCSO Act 2012 remains an un-repealed special statute. BNS does not replace POCSO.

query: What is the maximum section number in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023?
What is the maximum section number in the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023?
What is the maximum section number in the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023?
Which section of BNSS 2023 codifies Zero FIR registration?
Which section of BNSS 2023 governs Notice of Appearance prior to arrest?
Which section of BSA 2023 governs Primary Electronic Evidence?

A theft allegedly occurred on 29 June 2024. The FIR was registered electronically on 3 July 2024 in another district and signed by the informant on 5 July 2024; 12 days of police custody have been used; a search was not video-recorded; and laptop files, CCTV footage and WhatsApp messages were seized. Which substantive, procedural and evidence law applies, how much police custody remains, and do the defects establish innocence or automatic acquittal?
expected: Apply IPC sections 378 and 379 to the alleged theft, preserved by BNS section 358. Because the stated proceeding began after 1 July 2024, apply BNSS procedure under section 531 and BSA evidence law under section 170. The 5 July signature was within three days of the 3 July electronic report under BNSS section 173. IPC section 379's three-year maximum places detention under BNSS section 187 in the 60-day investigation category and the initial 40-day police-custody allocation window. Only if the earlier 12 police-custody days were validly authorised do no more than 3 aggregate days remain, still subject to that timing window and Magistrate authorisation. Address BNSS section 105 and BSA sections 62 and 63. The cited provisions do not themselves prescribe automatic exclusion, innocence or acquittal for the stated defects.
